author: Silver Cymbal
description:
Tick bites can happen in the city & the forest. But when you live in deep woods in New England with the highest population of deer ticks and Lyme disease in the country you learn how to protect yourself, kids and your property for these illness carrying insects. I share my own person secrets and methods for dealing with this horrible bug.
